decisions.reason: Adding an Enter option for the headline does not change field help-label text, placement, coverage, or persistence.
The accepted headline Enter option does not alter whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The source accepts a specific multiline-entry option for the headline and does not change the selected editable-field mechanism or legacy-field handling.
The source expands Enter support to a headline field but does not change the candidate's general hard-return spacing, Shift+Enter policy, or pasted-content behavior.
Headline multiline entry is unrelated to the approved theme colors and color-availability policy.
The source does not modify fixed margins or graphic-clipping prevention in the Vejledning template.
Adding Enter support to a headline does not resolve or change the legacy-to-new copy-paste workflow or its existing ambiguity.
The headline Enter option does not change the separate rule governing unintended borders when extending a Board Meeting Topic row.
The source decision has no effect on bullet size, alignment, color, scaling, or design.
The accepted Enter option does not modify the requested spacing between text and the line on the right.
